Container.Name: wavelength-hub
Container.Overview: Wavelength Hub: user accounts, roles (admin, member, kid), tinyauth single sign-on, device sign-in and settings sync for the Wavelength music app. Admin-only controls are enforced here, not just hidden in the app.

Config.Name: Web port
Config.Description: Hub port. Put Nginx Proxy Manager in front of it.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Database and secret key. Back this up.

Config.Name: Music share
Config.Description: Your music library (the folder Navidrome reads). yt-dlp downloads go into a folder inside it.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: The address people open in a browser, e.g. https://hub.example.com (your Nginx Proxy Manager host).

Config.Name: Single sign-on (tinyauth)
Config.Description: Turn on to sign in through tinyauth. Also set the proxy secret below.

Config.Name: Proxy secret
Config.Description: Long random value. Nginx Proxy Manager sends it as X-Wavelength-Proxy-Secret so the Hub trusts tinyauth's headers.

Config.Name: Trusted proxy IPs
Config.Description: Optional, comma separated: Nginx Proxy Manager's IP as the Hub sees it.

Config.Name: SSO admins
Config.Description: Comma separated tinyauth usernames that are always admins.

Config.Name: SSO admin group
Config.Description: Optional tinyauth group whose members are admins.

Config.Name: fanart.tv API key
Config.Description: Optional. A free fanart.tv API key adds its artist pictures and album covers to the cover art picker.

Config.Name: Auto-create SSO users
Config.Description: Create a member account the first time someone signs in through tinyauth. Off = you add people first.

Config.Name: Secret key
Config.Description: Optional 32-byte key (64 hex chars). Left empty, one is generated into appdata.
